-- Source: install.sql sha256:7c71e9c56b76d5fe893d2f357e692b9e7c458adc37791784379842ec1712d66d
-- Converter: schema-plan 0.3.0; rules sha256 2210687c65d791ec

BEGIN;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS app;
SET LOCAL search_path TO app;

-- Tables
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_roles (
    role_code varchar(30) NOT NULL,
    role_name varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    description varchar(400),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_roles_pk PRIMARY KEY (role_code)
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_user_roles (
    user_role_id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    username varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    role_code varchar(30) NOT NULL,
    created_by varchar(255),
    created_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    updated_by varchar(255),
    updated_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_user_roles_pk PRIMARY KEY (user_role_id),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_user_roles_u1 UNIQUE (username, role_code)
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_doc_types (
    doc_type varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    doc_name varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    prefix varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    table_name varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    pk_column varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    number_column varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    status_column varchar(128) DEFAULT 'STATUS' NOT NULL,
    amount_expr varchar(4000),
    validate_proc varchar(261),
    approver1_role varchar(30),
    approver2_role varchar(30),
    level2_limit numeric DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_doc_types_pk PRIMARY KEY (doc_type)
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_doc_seq (
    doc_type varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    period varchar(4) NOT NULL,
    last_no numeric DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_doc_seq_pk PRIMARY KEY (doc_type, period)
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_approvals (
    approval_id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    doc_type varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    doc_id numeric NOT NULL,
    doc_no varchar(30),
    approval_level numeric DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    approver_role varchar(30) NOT NULL,
    amount numeric,
    requested_by varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    requested_on timestamp(0) without time zone DEFAULT LOCALTIMESTAMP(0) NOT NULL,
    status varchar(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    acted_by varchar(255),
    acted_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    note varchar(1000),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_approvals_pk PRIMARY KEY (approval_id),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_approvals_ck1 CHECK (status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED'))
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_departments (
    department_id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    dept_code varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    dept_name varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    active_yn varchar(1) DEFAULT 'Y',
    created_by varchar(255),
    created_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    updated_by varchar(255),
    updated_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_departments_pk PRIMARY KEY (department_id),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_departments_u1 UNIQUE (dept_code),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_departments_ck1 CHECK (active_yn in ('Y', 'N'))
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_items (
    item_id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    item_code varchar(30) NOT NULL,
    item_name varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    category varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    uom varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    std_price numeric DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    active_yn varchar(1) DEFAULT 'Y',
    created_by varchar(255),
    created_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    updated_by varchar(255),
    updated_on timestamp(0) without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_items_pk PRIMARY KEY (item_id),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_items_u1 UNIQUE (item_code),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_items_ck1 CHECK (category in ('ATK', 'IT', 'CONSUMABLE')),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_items_ck2 CHECK (std_price >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT apx_demo_items_ck3 CHECK (active_yn in ('Y', 'N'))
);
CREATE TABLE app.apx_demo_requests (
    request_id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    request_no varchar(30),
    department_id bigint NOT NULL,
    request_date timestamp(0) without time zone DEFAULT CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS timestamp(0)) NOT NULL,
    need_date timestamp(0) without time zone,
    purpose varchar(300) NOT NULL,
    notes varchar(1000),
    status varchar(20) DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
    created_by varchar(255),

CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_user_roles_v AS

      ,ur.username
      ,ur.role_code
      ,r.role_name
      ,ur.created_by
      ,ur.created_on
  from apx_demo_user_roles ur
  join apx_demo_roles r on r.role_code = ur.role_code;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_departments_v AS
select t.department_id
      ,t.dept_code
      ,t.dept_name
      ,t.active_yn
      ,t.created_by
      ,t.created_on
      ,t.updated_by
      ,t.updated_on
  from apx_demo_departments t;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_items_v AS
select t.item_id
      ,t.item_code
      ,t.item_name
      ,t.category
      ,t.uom
      ,t.std_price
      ,t.active_yn
      ,t.created_by
      ,t.created_on
      ,t.updated_by
      ,t.updated_on
  from apx_demo_items t;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_requests_v AS
select t.request_id
      ,t.request_no
      ,t.department_id
      ,(select dept_code || ' - ' || dept_name from apx_demo_departments r where r.department_id = t.department_id) department_id_dsp
      ,t.request_date
      ,t.need_date
      ,t.purpose
      ,t.notes
      ,t.status
      ,t.created_by
      ,t.created_on
      ,t.updated_by
      ,t.updated_on
  from apx_demo_requests t;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_request_lines_v AS
select t.line_id
      ,t.request_id
      ,(select request_no || ' - ' || purpose from apx_demo_requests r where r.request_id = t.request_id) request_id_dsp
      ,t.item_id
      ,(select item_code || ' - ' || item_name || ' (' || uom || ')' from apx_demo_items r where r.item_id = t.item_id) item_id_dsp
      ,t.qty
      ,t.unit_price
      ,t.line_amount
      ,t.created_by
      ,t.created_on
      ,t.updated_by
      ,t.updated_on
  from apx_demo_request_lines t;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_dash_c1_s1_v AS
select status label, count(*) value from apx_demo_requests group by status;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_request_summary_v AS
select r.request_id
      ,r.request_no
      ,d.dept_name
      ,r.request_date
      ,r.purpose
      ,(select count(*) from apx_demo_request_lines l where l.request_id = r.request_id) line_count
      ,(select COALESCE(sum(l.line_amount), 0) from apx_demo_request_lines l where l.request_id = r.request_id) total_amount
      ,r.status
  from apx_demo_requests r
  join apx_demo_departments d on d.department_id = r.department_id;
CREATE VIEW app.apx_demo_dash_c2_s1_v AS
select dept_name label, sum(total_amount) value from apx_demo_request_summary_v group by dept_name;
